notes.key_messages:
In order to maximise their chances of success on this paper candidates should:
• ensure that they have provided an answer to all questions
• read all rubrics and questions very carefully
• make any alterations to a chosen answer clear
• allow time to re-check their answers.
notes.general_comments:
This paper presented candidates with a fair challenge of their knowledge and skills at this level. The majority
of candidates completed all sections of the paper and showed a confident understanding of the task types.
The standards of legibility and presentation were generally good.
